```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(httr)
  library(jsonlite)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(lubridate)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
})

readRenviron(".env")  # loads FRED_KEY from the git-ignored .env file
FRED_KEY <- Sys.getenv("FRED_KEY")
if (FRED_KEY == "") stop("FRED_KEY not set. Copy .env.example to .env and add your key.")

# ---- 1) Helpers ----
fred_obs <- function(series_id, observation_start = "1900-01-01", observation_end = Sys.Date()) {
  url <- "https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations"
  resp <- GET(url, query = list(
    series_id = series_id,
    api_key = FRED_KEY,
    file_type = "json",
    observation_start = observation_start,
    observation_end = as.character(observation_end)
  ))
  stop_for_status(resp)

  x <- fromJSON(content(resp, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
  tibble(
    date  = as.Date(x$observations$date),
    value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x$observations$value))
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    arrange(date)
}

to_monthly_avg <- function(df, value_col = "value") {
  df %>%
    mutate(month = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
    group_by(month) %>%
    summarise(value = mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    rename(date = month)
}

# ---- 2) Fed target (continuous) + policy change flag ----
# DFEDTAR ends 2008-12-15; range starts 2008-12-16.
dfedtar <- fred_obs("DFEDTAR", observation_start = "1982-09-01") %>%
  rename(dfedtar = value)

dfedtaru <- fred_obs("DFEDTARU", observation_start = "2008-11-01") %>%
  rename(dfedtaru = value)

dfedtarl <- fred_obs("DFEDTARL", observation_start = "2008-11-01") %>%
  rename(dfedtarl = value)

# Midpoint of the range (daily)
df_range_mid <- full_join(dfedtarl, dfedtaru, by = "date") %>%
  mutate(dfedtar_mid = (dfedtarl + dfedtaru) / 2) %>%
  select(date, dfedtar_mid)

# Continuous target (daily): DFEDTAR where available, else midpoint
ff_target_daily <- full_join(dfedtar, df_range_mid, by = "date") %>%
  mutate(ff_target = coalesce(dfedtar, dfedtar_mid)) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  select(date, ff_target)

# Policy Change (daily): TRUE if target changes from previous day
# (This flags change days, not literally “meeting day” calendar)
ff_target_daily <- ff_target_daily %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(policy_change_day = (ff_target != lag(ff_target))) %>%
  mutate(policy_change_day = if_else(is.na(policy_change_day), FALSE, policy_change_day))

# Convert to monthly:
# - ff_target: monthly average of daily target
# - policy_change: TRUE if any change day happened within the month
ff_target_monthly <- ff_target_daily %>%
  mutate(month = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(
    ff_target = mean(ff_target, na.rm = TRUE),
    policy_change = any(policy_change_day, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(date = month)

# ---- 3) Monthly series (already monthly on FRED) ----
monthly_ids <- c(
  "PCEPI", "PCEPILFE",
  "MICH",
  "UNRATE", "PAYEMS", "JTSJOL", "JTSQUR",
  "INDPRO", "PCEC96", "HOUST", "RRSFS"
)

monthly_tbls <- map(monthly_ids, ~{
  fred_obs(.x, observation_start = "1900-01-01") %>%
    rename(!!.x := value)
})

monthly_data <- reduce(monthly_tbls, full_join, by = "date")

# ---- 4) Daily/weekly series to monthly average ----
# (All of these are resampled to monthly average)
resample_ids <- c(
  # Inflation expectations (daily)
  "T5YIE",
  # Yields / curve (daily)
  "DGS3MO", "DGS2", "DGS10", "T10Y3M",
  # Credit spreads (daily)
  "BAMLH0A0HYM2", "BAA10Y",
  # Financial conditions (weekly)
  "ANFCI",
  # Dollar & commodities (daily)
  "DTWEXBGS", "DCOILWTICO"
)

resampled_tbls <- map(resample_ids, ~{
  fred_obs(.x, observation_start = "1900-01-01") %>%
    to_monthly_avg() %>%
    rename(!!.x := value)
})

resampled_data <- reduce(resampled_tbls, full_join, by = "date")

# ---- 5) Combine everything into one RAW monthly panel ----
raw_monthly <- ff_target_monthly %>%
  full_join(monthly_data, by = "date") %>%
  full_join(resampled_data, by = "date") %>%
  arrange(date)


# ---- 6) Save ----
write_csv(raw_monthly, "fred_raw_monthly_dataset.csv")

# Print quick summary
cat("Rows:", nrow(raw_monthly), "\n")
cat("Date range:", as.character(min(raw_monthly$date, na.rm = TRUE)), "to",
    as.character(max(raw_monthly$date, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
cat("Saved: fred_raw_monthly_dataset.csv\n")

# View head
print(head(raw_monthly, 12))

head(raw_monthly)

write.csv(
  raw_monthly,
  file = "fed_funds_raw.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


getwd()
list.files(pattern = "fed_funds_raw.csv")
```

```{r}


FRED_KEY <- Sys.getenv("FRED_KEY")

library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)
library(readr)


# ---- Helpers ----
fred_obs <- function(series_id, observation_start = "1982-09-01", observation_end = Sys.Date()) {
  url <- "https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations"
  resp <- GET(url, query = list(
    series_id         = series_id,
    api_key           = FRED_KEY,
    file_type         = "json",
    observation_start = observation_start,
    observation_end   = as.character(observation_end)
  ))
  stop_for_status(resp)
  x <- fromJSON(content(resp, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
  tibble(
    date  = as.Date(x$observations$date),
    value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x$observations$value))
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    arrange(date)
}

to_monthly_avg <- function(df, value_col = "value") {
  df %>%
    mutate(month = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
    group_by(month) %>%
    summarise(value = mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    rename(date = month)
}

# ---- Fetch DGS5 and DFII5 (daily → monthly average) ----
WTISPLC <- fred_obs("WTISPLC", observation_start = "1982-09-01") %>%
  to_monthly_avg() %>%
  rename(WTISPLC = value)

head(WTISPLC)

write.csv(WTISPLC, "WTISPLC.csv", row.names=FALSE)
```
